caption:
week one is mostly the app learning you. it says so instead of pretending

#fitnessapp #soma #routine

slides.text:
What the first week
actually looks like

Day 1 — it admits
it doesn't know you yet

And starts conservative

Day 3 — the sessions
start matching my sleep

Hard nights, lighter days

Day 5 — I stopped
negotiating with breakfast

The number was just there

Day 7 — three days
in a row

The first thing that felt easy

slides.heading: Week one is calibration
slides.body: SOMA starts careful, learns from your nights and sessions, and gets sharper every day you use it
